thread:
Jamie (Support): Ivy from Acme sent over this: around 12:12 UTC they saw a sudden spike of 502/504s for hosted inference calls. Customer says it started right after a batch job rotated their auth tokens and now their SDK is retrying in a tight loop. They attached a few request-ids: x-req-1=rdw-9a3c, rdw-9a4f, rdw-9a7b.
Ivy (Customer): Adding logs — our side we see a lot of 401s followed by simultaneous refresh attempts. snippet: `for conn in conns: if token_expired(): refresh()` (we know, messy). We flipped to an older token cache but errors persisted.
Jamie (Support): Pasted a couple gateway traces from our side: 502 from edge -> upstream auth 503 -> then streaming 504 for long polls. Sample trace: `edge: rdw-9a3c -> auth-service 503 -> model-runtime 502`.
Sasha (Eng): assigning to Mike. This smells like a token refresh thundering herd; SDKs sometimes don't coordinate refreshes so multiple clients hit /v1/auth/refresh at once, saturate auth backend, downstream becomes overloaded and we return 502/504 to customers.
Mike (API Eng): I pulled logs for those req ids. We have 2300 refresh calls in a 30s window from that customer org IP block, 99% to /v1/auth/refresh with 429/503 from auth-service. After that our gateway queued requests and started returning 502/timeouts to the runtime. Excerpt from auth logs: `2024-11-01T12:12:21Z auth refresh ip=34.76.x.x status=503 in_flight=420`.
Nora (Oncall SRE): Can we repro locally with a client that doesn't lock on refresh? Sasha, do we have a small harness?
Sasha (Eng): Yes, I can spin up a local repro. Quick test script I use (node):
```
const clients = Array.from({length:200}, _=> new Client({token: shortLived}));
clients.forEach(c => c.request({prompt:'hi'}));
```
This causes many simultaneous 401->refresh windows.
Ivy (Customer): FYI we have a scheduled job that rotates short-lived tokens every 5m which triggered during a bigger backlog. We didn't expect so many concurrent workers to all refresh at the same time.
Mike (API Eng): Immediate mitigation options: 1) Ask customer to temporarily increase token cache TTL client-side (if possible) or stagger rotation. 2) We can enable a gateway-side dedupe/aggregation on /v1/auth/refresh for a short window (3s) so only one refresh is forwarded per distinct subject. 3) Rate-limit refresh path per org/IP to protect auth backend. I recommend (2)+(?3) as quick fix.
Nora (Oncall SRE): I'll add a short-term rate-limit and dedupe rule to the edge for that org. Implementing now: `edgectl rate-limit create --path /v1/auth/refresh --key org:acme --rate 5/s --burst 10` and dedupe for 3s. Pushing..
token-refresh-bot: dedupe rule applied to org=acme path=/v1/auth/refresh window=3s (simulated).
Jamie (Support): Notifying Ivy about mitigation, will share rollback plan. Ivy, we'll enable this for ~30m and monitor.
Ivy (Customer): OK please do, our downstream errors spiked from ~0.3% to 12% of requests. We can pause the rotation if needed.
deploy-bot: edge rule rollout succeeded (canary -> 5 nodes)
Nora (Oncall SRE): Monitoring auth upstream errors now. Pre-change auth 5xx rate: 18/min. Post-change (5m): 2/min and gateway 502s dropped by ~90%.
Mike (API Eng): Good signal. Longer-term fix: SDK should implement a single-flight refresh (lock or promise de-dup) and we should add an in-edge single-flight aggregator for /v1/auth/refresh keyed by subject-id to collapse simultaneous refreshes. I'll open a PR for the SDK and a runtime ticket for edge aggregator.
Sasha (Eng): Repro notes attached: how to run load script against dev edge and confirm fold. Also captured a minimal PATCH for client-side: `if (refreshInProgress) await refreshInProgress; else refreshInProgress = doRefresh()`
Jamie (Support): Customer comms draft: "We identified a token-refresh fanout from concurrent workers that overwhelmed the auth service, causing 5xxs and timeouts. We enabled a short-term dedupe and rate-limit on your org while we work on an SDK patch to avoid simultaneous refreshes. Please avoid rotating tokens until we confirm fix in 24h or stagger rotation times." Want me to send?
Ivy (Customer): Send now please. We'll also open a ticket with our infra team to throttle the job start time.
Mike (API Eng): Creating follow-ups: GH-2456 SDK single-flight refresh (priority P1), GH-2457 edge aggregator for auth refresh, GH-2458 add additional observability (auth refresh counts per org).
Nora (Oncall SRE): I'll keep the temporary rule for 6h then remove unless we see reoccur. Logging shows no further 5xx spike in the last 10 minutes.
Jamie (Support): Sent customer update: "Temporary mitigation applied, monitoring, next steps include SDK patch and edge aggregator. ETA for SDK patch: tomorrow EOD; we'll follow up."
Ivy (Customer): Thanks — errors dropped to baseline. Will wait for SDK patch.
Mike (API Eng): Note: we'll also introduce a small token-ttl advisory in our docs for orgs that rotate tokens frequently.
Jamie (Support): Closing this thread for now; action items consolidated and assigned. If anything changes ping here.
Nora (Oncall SRE): marking incident as "mitigated" in incident tracker, will file full postmortem if we see recurrence.
Jamie (Support): resolved (temporary). Follow-ups: GH-2456, GH-2457, docs note.
